title: 젤렌스키 공개에 한국 정부 강력 반발

claims.text: 성기홍 홍보수석은 우크라이나 측이 양국 간 비공개 합의를 위반하고 일방적으로 공개한 것은 매우 심각한 문제라고 말했다.

evidence.spanText: “It is in itself a very serious matter that the Ukrainian side violated the confidentiality agreement between the two countries and made the disclosure unilaterally,” Seong Ghi-hong, senior presidential secretary for public relations, said Sunday night.
evidence.excerpt: “It is in itself a very serious matter that the Ukrainian side violated the confidentiality agreement between the two countries and made the disclosure unilaterally,” Seong Ghi-hong, senior presidential secretary for public relations, said Sunday night.

claims.text: 우크라이나 대사가 월요일 외교부로 소환됐고, 서울이 공식 사과와 경위 설명을 요구했다고 보도됐다.

evidence.spanText: The Ukrainian ambassador to South Korea was summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday as Seoul demands an official apology and an explanation of how this happened.
evidence.excerpt: The Ukrainian ambassador to South Korea was summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday as Seoul demands an official apology and an explanation of how this happened.

claims.text: 스티몬센터 한국프로그램 책임자 제임스 김은 젤렌스키의 공개가 이와 그의 정부를 심각한 곤경에 빠뜨려 대북 관계 정상화 노력을 타협하게 하거나 국내 반발을 초래할 것이라고 예상했다.

evidence.spanText: James Kim, director of the Korea Program at the Stimson Center, told the Washington Examiner that Zelensky’s disclosure has put Lee and his government in a terrible situation that will likely force them to compromise their campaign to normalize relations with the North or face domestic backlash.
